known_limitations: CI uses mocks and does not require real Ollama.
Extremely slow cold loads may require increasing the timeout environment variable.
local_smoke_test_instructions: python -m estate.cli.main resident-chat send --resident alfred --message "Alfred, give me a short operational greeting and say whether this came from the local LLM." --json
prompt_context_size_findings: Prompt context is bounded; context JSON slice reduced and final Alfred prompt capped at 6000 characters with per-response prompt size diagnostics.
recommended_next_action: Run the Steward-local smoke test against real Ollama/qwen3:8b.
root_cause: Provider discovery succeeded but /api/generate used a fixed 12 second timeout that was too short for Windows/Ollama cold-loading qwen3:8b, and process_chat labeled deterministic fallback as completed.
ui_changes: Alfred panel shows generation result, timeout seconds, prompt size summary, and recovery hint; per-turn line prefixes degraded fallback.
